evidence_rules: Each promised gameplay feature needs an executing scenario with observable actions and semantic expectations against the installed candidate hash.
Each case may begin at a supplied private native save state, with exact state hash and provenance recorded; fixtures cannot stand in for a fresh-start progression witness.
Imported player-facing behaviors need stock-ROM controls showing the promised behavior is absent, not a failure caused by incompatible state or observation format.
Numerical movement changes and hook presence do not establish combat, enemies, abilities, progression or a completed first draft.
Missing cases fail coverage. Do not replace these requirements with a smaller passing suite or synthetic memory assertions unrelated to reachable gameplay.
